name: agentic-vault
description: Shared Markdown memory, bounded session context, source-attributed recall and verified backups for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.32.0: default-path heading, frontmatter, code-span and wiki-link parsing runs in linear time with the same results on tested inputs. check-support no longer joins text across a removed fact table, splits cited bodies only at CR/LF and drops a self-cited ledger's BOM; only these cases change its default output. Opt-in --normalize-periods abstains on more misread forms and compares a few forms that v0.31.0 abstained on as whole periods (초과, 2주 차질, a time or count after a list separator). New opt-in tools: evaluate_recall --gold-removal-twins and keyed --redact-row-order token, a real-vault sample audit with an exact hypergeometric miss bound, and a Claude Code-only deny-zone PreToolUse guard template, never installed by default. checker_sha256 changes: if warnings were promoted to fatal, revert them to warning, bring the Claude Code and Codex installations and a git vault's 00-meta/scripts engine copy to the same version (also when rolling back), regenerate the certificate there, then promote again. No model/network call, default hook change or automatic vault migration is added.
defaultPrompt: Use agentic-vault to restore this vault's session context.
Use agentic-vault to find the sources for our last deployment decision.
